en: The Stormpike General is dead!
Can I help you?
The forest told me of your presence, but not why you were here. So, speak and enlighten me.
Can you feel the power, $n??? It's time to ROCK!
The children of Sul will protect their master. Rise once more Sul'lithuz!
You seek to lure me from my clutch? You shall pay for your insolence!
The things I would teach you would turn your brain to jelly! Come back when you've learned sufficiently!
Not only am I havin' all the mithril bars I be needin', but all the Horde collections are done now mon. It's lookin' like we just waitin' on the Alliance and then we be goin' to war!

I can't say enough about yer work, truly amazing things that ye can do with a hammer and an anvil. Now, don't be tellin anyone that I suggested ye go find a goblin to teach ye but that's exactly what I'm gonna do. Brikk Keencraft is his name, and last I heard he was operating a shop down in Booty Bay.
I need to go. Evil stirs. Die well, Omarion.
The bottles are dusty but the liquor goes down clean!
I still do not fully understand.
Continue with your story please.
Fordring shall never see his son.
Dazalar is well known around Dolanaar for his hunting skill.  Why don't you talk to him and see what he can teach you?
Ya mon, I be Gadrin's assistant.  Dis here volunteer work be my way of gettin through Witch Doctor School.  Since you help him, I help ya for free.  Whatcha need fixin?
You're hunting Deathclasp, $n?  Color me impressed.  I lost two of my men to her this week alone.  Let's hope your luck is better than theirs.
Myolor, I was once an armorsmith and wish to retake the hammer once more! Teach me the way of the armorsmith.
I have lost my Band of Veiled Shadows. Are you able to replace it for me?
OH NOES!  Da king is dead!  Uh... hail to da new king!  Yeah!
Be cleansed by blade, filth!
Lok'tar $c!  We have need of your services in Alterac Valley.  Shall I add you to the lists?
I can tell that your wardrobe is in dire need of care.
To arms!  Scourge spotted in the Cathedral of Light!
In the throes of the Sundering, Ameth'Aran was at the whim of the terror that gripped the land. There was little hope for survival.
I hear wedding bells in your future.
%s uses $n's offering in a ritual...
Wait!  What am I thinking!  We have a job to do with this stuff.

Heya, $c, don't you know? The Horde is done with all of its collecting. We're just finishing up final preparations while we wait for the Alliance to finish their gathering. Then it will be time to ship everything over to Silithus for the war.

Windsor was particularly ornery that day - and believe me, for Windsor, that's a monumental accomplishment. He kept telling me that 'something feels off.' Well he wasn't kidding!$B$BWe were in the middle of Blackrock Mountain when the filthy animals attacked. I'm talking about the orcs, of course. Pay attention, will ya? All you could hear were grunts and the clanging of steel as they rushed us.

I am a mage of great power, I have spent my days studying the mind and the memory as it pertains to learning and the retention of learned abilities. I would even now be perfecting my studies if not for the great voices that came to me in the night, informing me that my services were required. I will be here for only a short time offering my ability to wipe your talents for free. Soon I will leave again, and you will once more be stuck with whatever choices you make.
If my calculations are correct, the wheel will soon be obsolete!
Thanks again, $n.  Rocknot and I are really hitting it off!
These are good blades you make, $n. Cut a stone and still sharp enough to slit a throat. I have seen better though, an orc named Kelgrum Bloodaxe makes them, go and learn all he can teach you.
You made it?! I'm surprised Kinelory didn't slow you down anymore than that. Kin, here's your socks. Give me what you found ins
